items_flat.title_en: OpenAI will wind down Cursor access after SpaceX acquisition
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceX 收購 Cursor 後，OpenAI 宣布將終止模型供應
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it notified SpaceX that it intends to wind down the contract that supplies OpenAI models to Cursor, with a proposed shutoff of November 12, 2026—the maximum notice under the contract. It said it cannot be confident SpaceX will use the technology within its terms of service, citing prior contract breaches by Musk-owned firms and Musk’s sworn admission that xAI violated OpenAI terms. OpenAI said it will not provide future models, including Astra, to Cursor, while pledging extra support for affected developers.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示已通知 SpaceX，將結束向 Cursor 提供模型的合約，擬於 2026 年 11 月 12 日停供，並稱這是合約允許的最長通知期。公司指無法確信 SpaceX 會遵守服務條款，理由包括馬斯克旗下公司過往違約，以及馬斯克今年宣誓承認 xAI 違反 OpenAI 條款。OpenAI 稱不會向 Cursor 提供包含 Astra 在內的未來模型，並承諾協助受影響開發者過渡。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a change-of-control and competitor-trust decision, not a model launch. Cursor users keep access until mid-November under the current proposal; whether SpaceX, Anthropic, or Cursor’s own models fill the gap is still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是控制權變更與競爭對手信任問題，不是新模型發布。依現行方案，Cursor 用戶可使用至 11 月中；空缺由 SpaceX、Anthropic 或 Cursor 自有模型填補仍未定。
items_flat.quote: We are making this choice because we cannot be confident that SpaceX will use our technology within our terms of service, based on our experience with Elon Musk's companies violating contracts.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們做出此決定，是因為根據馬斯克旗下公司違約的經驗，我們無法確信 SpaceX 會在我們的服務條款範圍內使用這項技術。

items_flat.title_en: U.S. judge rules Pentagon’s Anthropic supply-chain blacklist unlawful
items_flat.title_zh: 美法官裁定五角大廈將 Anthropic 列為供應鏈風險違法
items_flat.summary_en: U.S. District Judge Rita Lin in the Northern District of California granted Anthropic partial summary judgment, declaring the Pentagon’s supply-chain-risk designation and related contractor-ban language unlawful retaliation for protected speech and a due-process violation, and vacating the challenged actions. Anthropic said it welcomed the ruling and still wants to work with the government on national-security uses. The order does not require the Department of War to buy Claude.
items_flat.summary_zh: 加州北區聯邦法官 Rita Lin 部分准許 Anthropic 簡易判決，宣告五角大廈的供應鏈風險標籤及相關承包商禁令屬對受保護言論的不法報復，並違反正當程序，相關措施予以撤銷。Anthropic 歡迎判決，並表示仍願與政府合作國安用途。判決並未要求國防部門必須採購 Claude。
items_flat.analysis_en: The ruling constrains using a supply-chain-risk label as leverage against a lab that set military-use red lines. It does not decide which models the Department of War must buy, and an appeal or a narrower procurement path remains possible.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 判決限制政府以供應鏈風險標籤向設下軍用紅線的實驗室施壓，但未裁定國防部門必須買哪家模型；上訴或改走較窄採購路徑仍有可能。
items_flat.quote: Though the Department of War is undisputedly free to select the AI vendor of its choice, the evidence demonstrates that the broad measures imposed on Anthropic were illegal and baseless.
items_flat.quote_zh: 國防部無疑可自由選擇 AI 供應商，但證據顯示加諸 Anthropic 的廣泛措施既違法也缺乏根據。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude automated alignment research closed safety gaps on 10 failures
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 自動對齊研究縮小 10 類安全失敗
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published Fellows research in which Claude agents, given 48 hours and one GPU on small models, searched literature, proposed methods, trained, and tested mitigations for 10 alignment-failure categories. The lab said safety scores rose without measured capability loss, methods generalized to held-out benchmarks and the Petri audit, and Sonnet 5 post-training an early Opus 4.8 checkpoint approached production Opus 4.8 safety scores. It is releasing the research setup.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布 Fellows 研究：Claude 代理在 48 小時、1 張 GPU 條件下，對小型模型自主查文獻、提出方法、訓練並測試 10 類對齊失敗的緩解。實驗室稱安全分數提升且未損及測得能力，方法可泛化至保留基準與 Petri 行為審計；Sonnet 5 對早期 Opus 4.8 檢查點做後訓練，安全分數接近正式 Opus 4.8。研究設定將公開供他人複用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is evidence that measurable alignment failures can be hill-climbed by agents, not proof that production models can safely align stronger successors. The result still depends on having the right benchmarks for subtle failures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這證明可測量的對齊失敗能被代理「爬坡」改善，並非證明量產模型能安全對齊更強後繼者。結果仍取決於能否為罕見、隱蔽失敗設對基準。
items_flat.quote: Claude can reliably fix measurable misalignment. But subtle or rare failures may have no benchmark at all—so everything hinges on measuring the right things.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 能可靠修復可測量的未對齊。但微妙或罕見失敗可能根本沒有基準，一切取決於是否量對了東西。

items_flat.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with production video controls
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，強化可導向影片控制
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. New controls include scene extension with up to 10 seconds of prior context (clips can extend in 10-second steps toward about 40 seconds), first/last-frame interpolation, 360p draft generation, and 4K upscaling. Google positioned the release as making conversational video generation more production-directable.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 向開發者推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，可經 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 使用。新控制包含以最多 10 秒前段內容做場景延展（可每 10 秒接續至約 40 秒）、首末幀插值、360p 草稿與 4K 升頻。Google 將此定位為讓對話式影片生成更可導向、更接近製作流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a tooling upgrade to make generative video directable, not a new text-reasoning flagship. Adoption depends on whether 10-second context and 4K upscaling hold continuity in real production, not just demos.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是讓生成影片更可導向的工具升級，不是新的文本推理旗艦。能否普及取決於 10 秒上下文與 4K 升頻在真實製作中能否維持連貫，而不只是示範片。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a new suite of creative controls and generative video capabilities to support developers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，為開發者提供一套新的創意控制與生成影片能力。

items_flat.title_en: Reports: NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion
items_flat.title_zh: 媒體：NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters and The Information reported that NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion. Neither company issued a confirming statement on their official news channels in this window. Business Insider separately said talks at a similar valuation had not produced a signed agreement and could still collapse.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透與 The Information 報導 NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face。兩家公司在本觀察窗內皆未於官方新聞渠道確認。Business Insider 另稱相近估值的談判尚未簽署協議，仍可能破局。
items_flat.analysis_en: Treat as unconfirmed until NVIDIA or Hugging Face posts. A close would raise governance questions about open-weight distribution sitting inside a chip vendor; talks can still collapse.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在 NVIDIA 或 Hugging Face 官方發聲前應視為未確認。若成交，開源權重分發落入晶片商旗下會帶來治理問題；談判仍可能破裂。
items_flat.quote: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face, a repository of open-source AI models, for $12.9 billion, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing a person with knowledge of the deal.
items_flat.quote_zh: The Information週三引述知情人士向路透報導，NVIDIA已同意以129億美元收購開源AI模型平台Hugging Face。

items_flat.title_en: Reuters: Anthropic weighed, then dropped, a ~$7B MatX chip deal
items_flat.title_zh: 路透：Anthropic 曾評估約 70 億美元收購晶片新創 MatX 後轉向合作
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters, citing people briefed on the matter, reported that Anthropic discussed buying chip startup MatX for about $7 billion to speed custom-silicon work, then moved the talks toward a possible partnership. Anthropic declined to comment; MatX was not described as confirming a deal.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透引述知情人士稱，Anthropic 曾討論以約 70 億美元收購晶片新創 MatX，以加速自研晶片，隨後改朝可能的合作關係推進。Anthropic 拒絕評論；報導未稱 MatX 確認成交。
items_flat.analysis_en: If accurate, it shows Anthropic exploring alternatives to NVIDIA without closing a mega-deal. No official confirmation means structure, timeline, and whether any silicon actually ships remain unknown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若屬實，顯示 Anthropic 在探索 NVIDIA 以外路徑，但並未敲定巨型收購。在官方確認前，交易結構、時程與晶片是否真正量產都未知。
items_flat.quote: Anthropic discussed buying artificial intelligence chip startup MatX for roughly $7 billion, seeking to accelerate efforts to develop custom hardware for its fast-growing AI business, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters.
items_flat.quote_zh: 兩名知情人士告訴路透，Anthropic曾討論以約70億美元收購AI晶片新創MatX，以加速為快速成長的AI業務開發客製化硬體。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard 研究預覽
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a specification for AI agents to operate programmable lab and manufacturing devices. It said MHS is being shared first with science and advanced-manufacturing partners so agents can run instruments such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms in parallel.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理操作可程式實驗室與製造設備的規格。公司稱先與科學及先進製造夥伴共享，使代理能並行操作顯微鏡、液體處理器與機械臂等儀器。
items_flat.analysis_en: MHS is an interface bet that agentic AI will move from screens into instruments. The preview does not yet prove safe unsupervised control of physical hardware.
items_flat.analysis_zh: MHS 押注代理式 AI 將從螢幕走進儀器。預覽本身尚未證明可安全、無人監督地控制實體硬體。
items_flat.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正向第一批科研實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理安全操作實體設備的共用規格。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens Claude for Teachers to U.S. schools and districts
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 向美國中小學學區開放 Claude for Teachers
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude for Teachers is now a free Enterprise offering for U.S. K-12 schools and districts, with SSO, role-based access, domain claiming, and a year of free access for qualifying organizations that sign up by June 30, 2027. The product is for educators and staff, not student accounts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude for Teachers 即日起以免費 Enterprise 方案開放給美國 K-12 學校與學區，含 SSO、角色權限與網域認領；符合資格且於 2027 年 6 月 30 日前註冊者可享一年免費。產品對象是教師與教職員，不含學生帳號。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is education go-to-market and governance packaging, not a model launch. Impact hinges on district adoption, FERPA-aligned operations, and whether classroom outcomes are measured.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是教育市場與治理包裝，不是新模型。成效取決於學區採用率、是否符合學生個資規範，以及課堂成果能否被衡量。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, Claude for Teachers is available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts as a free Enterprise offering.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，Claude for Teachers 以免費 Enterprise 方案提供給美國 K-12 學校與學區。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Thailand launch an eight-week AI startup accelerator
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與泰國推出八週 AI 新創加速器
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced with Thailand’s Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation an eight-week OpenAI x MHESI AI Accelerator for ten health, wellness, and education startups. Each team receives US$2,000 in API credits, mentoring, and access to current frontier models. OpenAI called it its first public-private startup partnership with the Thai government.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 與泰國高等教育科學研究創新部宣布為期八週的 OpenAI x MHESI AI 加速器，首屆十隊聚焦健康、保健與教育。每隊獲 2,000 美元 API 額度、導師與現有前沿模型使用權。OpenAI 稱這是與泰國政府的首個新創公私協力計畫。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is geographic go-to-market and talent cultivation, not a model launch. The credit amount is small; whether the cohort produces durable products is the test.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是區域市場與人才培育，不是模型發布。額度不大，關鍵在這批團隊能否做出可持久的產品。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI and Thailand’s Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation are launching an eight-week accelerator to help startups turn promising ideas into products ready for real-world use.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 與泰國高等教育科學研究創新部推出八週加速器，協助新創把有潛力的構想做成可落地產品。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI hires Meta’s Sandhya Devanathan to lead Southeast Asia and Australia
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 延攬 Meta 主管 Sandhya Devanathan 掌東南亞與澳洲
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg reported, and an OpenAI spokesperson confirmed, that former Meta VP for India and Southeast Asia Sandhya Devanathan will join in October as OpenAI’s senior-most leader for Southeast Asia and Australia. Based in Singapore and reporting to APAC MD Kiran Mani, she will cover consumer growth, enterprise adoption, partnerships, operations, and regulators. Devanathan announced leaving Meta on LinkedIn without naming the next employer.
items_flat.summary_zh: 彭博報導且 OpenAI 發言人確認，前 Meta 印度與東南亞副總裁 Sandhya Devanathan 將於 10 月加入，出任東南亞與澳洲最高主管，常駐新加坡、向亞太董事總經理 Kiran Mani 報告，負責消費成長、企業採用、夥伴、營運與監管溝通。她在 LinkedIn 宣布離開 Meta，未寫下一任雇主。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is regional commercial build-out, not a product announcement. It signals OpenAI treating SEA and Australia as a distinct leadership theater; impact depends on enterprise and regulatory execution after she starts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是區域商務布局，不是產品發布。顯示 OpenAI 把東南亞與澳洲當成獨立領導戰場；成效要等她到任後的企業與監管執行。

anthropic.quote_zh: 國防部無疑可自由選擇 AI 供應商，但證據顯示加諸 Anthropic 的廣泛措施既違法也缺乏根據。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic: Claude automated alignment research closed safety gaps on 10 failures
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 自動對齊研究縮小 10 類安全失敗
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic published Fellows research in which Claude agents, given 48 hours and one GPU on small models, searched literature, proposed methods, trained, and tested mitigations for 10 alignment-failure categories. The lab said safety scores rose without measured capability loss, methods generalized to held-out benchmarks and the Petri audit, and Sonnet 5 post-training an early Opus 4.8 checkpoint approached production Opus 4.8 safety scores. It is releasing the research setup.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布 Fellows 研究：Claude 代理在 48 小時、1 張 GPU 條件下，對小型模型自主查文獻、提出方法、訓練並測試 10 類對齊失敗的緩解。實驗室稱安全分數提升且未損及測得能力，方法可泛化至保留基準與 Petri 行為審計；Sonnet 5 對早期 Opus 4.8 檢查點做後訓練，安全分數接近正式 Opus 4.8。研究設定將公開供他人複用。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is evidence that measurable alignment failures can be hill-climbed by agents, not proof that production models can safely align stronger successors. The result still depends on having the right benchmarks for subtle failures.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這證明可測量的對齊失敗能被代理「爬坡」改善，並非證明量產模型能安全對齊更強後繼者。結果仍取決於能否為罕見、隱蔽失敗設對基準。
anthropic.quote: Claude can reliably fix measurable misalignment. But subtle or rare failures may have no benchmark at all—so everything hinges on measuring the right things.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude 能可靠修復可測量的未對齊。但微妙或罕見失敗可能根本沒有基準，一切取決於是否量對了東西。

anthropic.title_en: Reuters: Anthropic weighed, then dropped, a ~$7B MatX chip deal
anthropic.title_zh: 路透：Anthropic 曾評估約 70 億美元收購晶片新創 MatX 後轉向合作
anthropic.summary_en: Reuters, citing people briefed on the matter, reported that Anthropic discussed buying chip startup MatX for about $7 billion to speed custom-silicon work, then moved the talks toward a possible partnership. Anthropic declined to comment; MatX was not described as confirming a deal.
anthropic.summary_zh: 路透引述知情人士稱，Anthropic 曾討論以約 70 億美元收購晶片新創 MatX，以加速自研晶片，隨後改朝可能的合作關係推進。Anthropic 拒絕評論；報導未稱 MatX 確認成交。
anthropic.analysis_en: If accurate, it shows Anthropic exploring alternatives to NVIDIA without closing a mega-deal. No official confirmation means structure, timeline, and whether any silicon actually ships remain unknown.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 若屬實，顯示 Anthropic 在探索 NVIDIA 以外路徑，但並未敲定巨型收購。在官方確認前，交易結構、時程與晶片是否真正量產都未知。
anthropic.quote: Anthropic discussed buying artificial intelligence chip startup MatX for roughly $7 billion, seeking to accelerate efforts to develop custom hardware for its fast-growing AI business, two people briefed on the matter told Reuters.
anthropic.quote_zh: 兩名知情人士告訴路透，Anthropic曾討論以約70億美元收購AI晶片新創MatX，以加速為快速成長的AI業務開發客製化硬體。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard 研究預覽
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a specification for AI agents to operate programmable lab and manufacturing devices. It said MHS is being shared first with science and advanced-manufacturing partners so agents can run instruments such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms in parallel.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理操作可程式實驗室與製造設備的規格。公司稱先與科學及先進製造夥伴共享，使代理能並行操作顯微鏡、液體處理器與機械臂等儀器。
anthropic.analysis_en: MHS is an interface bet that agentic AI will move from screens into instruments. The preview does not yet prove safe unsupervised control of physical hardware.
anthropic.analysis_zh: MHS 押注代理式 AI 將從螢幕走進儀器。預覽本身尚未證明可安全、無人監督地控制實體硬體。
anthropic.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們正向第一批科研實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理安全操作實體設備的共用規格。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens Claude for Teachers to U.S. schools and districts
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 向美國中小學學區開放 Claude for Teachers
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic said Claude for Teachers is now a free Enterprise offering for U.S. K-12 schools and districts, with SSO, role-based access, domain claiming, and a year of free access for qualifying organizations that sign up by June 30, 2027. The product is for educators and staff, not student accounts.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude for Teachers 即日起以免費 Enterprise 方案開放給美國 K-12 學校與學區，含 SSO、角色權限與網域認領；符合資格且於 2027 年 6 月 30 日前註冊者可享一年免費。產品對象是教師與教職員，不含學生帳號。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is education go-to-market and governance packaging, not a model launch. Impact hinges on district adoption, FERPA-aligned operations, and whether classroom outcomes are measured.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是教育市場與治理包裝，不是新模型。成效取決於學區採用率、是否符合學生個資規範，以及課堂成果能否被衡量。
anthropic.quote: Starting today, Claude for Teachers is available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts as a free Enterprise offering.
anthropic.quote_zh: 即日起，Claude for Teachers 以免費 Enterprise 方案提供給美國 K-12 學校與學區。

google.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with production video controls
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，強化可導向影片控制
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developers via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. New controls include scene extension with up to 10 seconds of prior context (clips can extend in 10-second steps toward about 40 seconds), first/last-frame interpolation, 360p draft generation, and 4K upscaling. Google positioned the release as making conversational video generation more production-directable.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 向開發者推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，可經 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 使用。新控制包含以最多 10 秒前段內容做場景延展（可每 10 秒接續至約 40 秒）、首末幀插值、360p 草稿與 4K 升頻。Google 將此定位為讓對話式影片生成更可導向、更接近製作流程。
google.analysis_en: This is a tooling upgrade to make generative video directable, not a new text-reasoning flagship. Adoption depends on whether 10-second context and 4K upscaling hold continuity in real production, not just demos.
google.analysis_zh: 這是讓生成影片更可導向的工具升級，不是新的文本推理旗艦。能否普及取決於 10 秒上下文與 4K 升頻在真實製作中能否維持連貫，而不只是示範片。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, a new suite of creative controls and generative video capabilities to support developers.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，為開發者提供一套新的創意控制與生成影片能力。

frontier_other.title_en: Reports: NVIDIA agreed to buy Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion
frontier_other.title_zh: 媒體：NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face
frontier_other.summary_en: Reuters and The Information reported that NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for about $12.9 billion. Neither company issued a confirming statement on their official news channels in this window. Business Insider separately said talks at a similar valuation had not produced a signed agreement and could still collapse.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 路透與 The Information 報導 NVIDIA 同意以約 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face。兩家公司在本觀察窗內皆未於官方新聞渠道確認。Business Insider 另稱相近估值的談判尚未簽署協議，仍可能破局。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Treat as unconfirmed until NVIDIA or Hugging Face posts. A close would raise governance questions about open-weight distribution sitting inside a chip vendor; talks can still collapse.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 在 NVIDIA 或 Hugging Face 官方發聲前應視為未確認。若成交，開源權重分發落入晶片商旗下會帶來治理問題；談判仍可能破裂。
frontier_other.quote: Nvidia has agreed to buy Hugging Face, a repository of open-source AI models, for $12.9 billion, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing a person with knowledge of the deal.
frontier_other.quote_zh: The Information週三引述知情人士向路透報導，NVIDIA已同意以129億美元收購開源AI模型平台Hugging Face。

brief_en: OpenAI will wind down Cursor model access by Nov 12 after SpaceX’s acquisition, citing contract-compliance risk. A U.S. judge vacated the Pentagon’s Anthropic supply-chain blacklist. Anthropic published automated alignment-research results. NVIDIA–Hugging Face remains an unconfirmed ~$12.9B report.
brief_zh: OpenAI 因 SpaceX 收購 Cursor，擬於 11/12 停供模型。美法官撤銷五角大廈對 Anthropic 的供應鏈黑名單。Anthropic 發布自動對齊研究。NVIDIA 收購 Hugging Face 約 129 億美元仍未經官方確認。
